name: Maximum Carnage, Part 8: Hate is in the Air
title: Spider-Man #36
desc: While out at Cap's base of the Avengers they realize something is in the computer and they track it down and see Deathlok on screen along with Iron Fist. Spider-man then asks everyone to meet him back at Avengers headquarters at five. While Carnage and Shriek have Venom kept up in the Statue of Liberty torturing him, Spider-man returns to MJ. Meanwhile Carnage's "Kids" find Black Cat and Cloak and start fighting them and almost killing them when Cloak teleports Morbius away to safety, leaving the Black Cat behind. She is then saved by Nightwatch, and decides she doesn't want to lose her life over this and heads home.
